signs.label: UNCHANGED 10-29
signs.finding: No 1Q27 conventional DRAM contract guide has followed TrendForce's 4Q26 +10–15 % q/q call ("pace moderating", 09-30); the TrendForce press page through 10-29 carries nothing on contract prices, while the two Korean memory prints came in hot on realized Q3 pricing: SK hynix's Q3 DRAM ASP rose a high-20s % q/q on about 10 % more bits with no Q4 price outlook given (TrendForce News 10-28), and Samsung's Q3 release says strong server demand lifted market prices across all applications and names no Q4 contract pace (Samsung 10-29), 10-29
signs.why: the contract GUIDE is the part of the DRAM lead no dash series carries; it feeds the Micron family
signs.measurable: bear = TrendForce next-quarter conventional DRAM contract guide ≤ 0 % q/q; neutral = positive but "moderating"; fizzle = ≥ +10 % q/q
search: TrendForce DRAM contract price forecast 4Q26 OR 1Q27 QoQ

signs.label: CHANGED
signs.finding: SK hynix finalized 2027 HBM volumes and pricing with major customers on terms reflecting HBM4's higher value, with 14 long-term-agreement customers covering more than half of 2027–28 output and HBM4 set to pass HBM3E in shipments and revenue in 4Q26 (TrendForce News 10-28); Samsung's Q3 release says HBM4 sales were significantly scaled up and 2027 AI demand will far exceed supply (Samsung 10-29); no 2027 oversupply or ASP-cut item sourced; TrendForce's 2027 blended HBM ASP +121 % y/y call (09-29) stands as the only % guide, 10-29
signs.why: HBM is Micron's margin engine; an oversupply call or a share loss is the AI-specific path to an MU bear
signs.measurable: bear = a sourced 2027 "HBM oversupply"/ASP-cut item, Micron share < 15 %, or HBM4 settling < 2× HBM3E; fizzle = 2027 ASP guide ≥ +50 %
search: HBM4 price 2027 Micron SK hynix Samsung oversupply

signs.label: CHANGED
signs.finding: capex bear clause now met alongside the funding one: Microsoft cut its 2026 capex forecast to $170 B from $175 B after a $45.2 B quarter against a $50 B plan, blaming third-party GPU capacity delays into 1H27, not a pullback (CNBC 10-29, TechCrunch 10-30); Alphabet held 2026 at $195–205 B and said 2027 rises significantly, Amazon held 2026 near $220 B with 2027 meaningfully higher, no digestion wording — but the tape punished the spend: Alphabet −12 % on 10-29, its worst day on record, Amazon −7 %, Nasdaq −2.9 % on 10-30, three of four with negative free cash flow and $326 B of 2026 debt raised across the five AI payers (TechCrunch 10-30), 10-30
signs.why: a hyperscaler capex cut is the demand-destruction path for memory; AI-capex funding stress is its early form
signs.measurable: capex bear = any of the four lowers 2026/27 or says "digestion/pause" on the 10-28/29 calls; funding bear = a named AI/DC deal withdrawn, Hyperion < 85 ¢, or ORCL CDS junk-implied; fizzle = all four raise
search: hyperscaler capex guidance cut OR digestion earnings call
AI data center bond pulled OR repriced

signs.label: UNSOURCED
signs.finding: Taoyuan union held a 24-hour warning strike 10-22 to 10-23 with 11 union officers, not meant to stop production, and warned more workers could join (Focus Taiwan 10-22); Micron answered on 10-23 with a global profit-sharing plan as the Taiwan union struck (Taiwan News 10-23), no Taoyuan settlement or MOU sourced; Taichung signed an agreement 10-21 and dropped mediation, 10-23
signs.why: the one dated Micron-specific catalyst: a strike at the Taiwan DRAM fabs hits MU supply and sentiment inside the window
signs.measurable: bear = a strike date set or Taichung authorizes; BLOCKING = strike begins or a 48-h ultimatum; fizzle = settlement/MOU
search: Micron Taiwan union strike Taoyuan Taichung
searchNext: Micron Taoyuan union profit sharing talks result

signs.label: CHANGED
signs.finding: BoJ held at 1.25 % on 10-30 by 8–1, Takata dissenting for 1.5 %, and raised its ETF sales pace from January 2027 (BoJ 10-30); the yen firmed only modestly, USD/JPY — intraday 10-30 on a third session of gains, with FXStreet reading core inflation at target as raising a December hike and a fresh intervention warning from Finance Minister Katayama leaving USD/JPY near — (FXStreet 10-30); no carry unwind, and the last CFTC read (week to 10-13) still shows leveraged funds adding to the yen short, 10-30
signs.why: a yen carry unwind (Aug-2024) hits crowded semis first; the yen family trips on F17 off its high or on this row's block
signs.measurable: bear = carry being added (CFTC JPY spec net short growing or at a record) or Oct-hike pricing > 50 %; BLOCKING = a BoJ hike + hawkish guidance (the 10-30 event's escalationIf) or MoF intervention (the price leg is the probe's F17 read); fizzle = Oct < 25 % and no spec-short build
search: USD/JPY BoJ October hike pricing yen carry unwind

signs.label: CHANGED
signs.finding: round cut again: OpenAI lowered its funding target to $20 B from $30 B with a first close expected lower still, led by UAE investors, after the valuation had already slipped to $1.25 T from $1.4 T; WSJ says $11 B is secured so far against a "tepid" response from large investors (FT/WSJ via TechCrunch 10-31); Anthropic filed to go public and is expected to draw a high-junk rating, per the FT (TechCrunch 10-30); run rate last ~$50 B end-September with a ≥ $70 B year-end target (Bloomberg 10-08/09), 10-31

signs.measurable: bear = an OpenAI/Anthropic run-rate cut, a repriced or delayed round, ORCL CDS > 203 bp or a junk cut; fizzle = OpenAI run-rate re-confirmed ≥ $65 B
search: Anthropic run-rate revenue OR funding round valuation

signs.label: CHANGED
signs.finding: CCC OAS — close 10-29, still above the 12.5 % bear line but off its — 10-23 high, while broad HY sits just under its 3.5 % line (FRED BAMLH0A3HYC 10-29); Q3 non-traded BDC tenders: 19 NAV BDCs took requests for 11.5 % of NAV vs 12.7 % in Q2, filled 40 %, $8.2 B unmet, with BCRED, Blue Owl Credit Income and Apollo Debt Solutions all holding payouts to their 5 % caps (Stanger via AltsWire 10-02) — the gating clause stays met, 10-29

signs.label: UNCHANGED 11-01
signs.finding: Full-month Oct chip exports $56.4 B, +259 % y/y, inside a record $115.3 B total (+93.7 %) and a $42.5 B surplus (MOTIE via Korea Times 11-01); the 1st-20-day window the row scores stays a first sequential fall — Oct 1–20 chips $27.5 B over 13 working days, about $2.1 B per day against about $2.2 B in Sep 1–20 (KCS via Korea Times 10-21), 11-01
signs.why: Korea's 1st-20-day chip exports are the earliest hard print of memory demand (Samsung + Hynix ≈ the DRAM/HBM market); a rollover there leads Micron's guide, so it feeds the Micron family
signs.measurable: per working day vs the prior month's 1st-20-day window: bear = a sequential fall; BLOCKING = two straight sequential falls; fizzle = a new 1st-20-day record
search: Korea exports first 20 days October 2026 semiconductors

situation.lean: Stay out: credit stress still shuts every tranche, and the late-October hyperscaler round turned the capex signal bear alongside the AI-funding one. Rates and the yen both landed on the calm side, so the bear tilt now rests on credit, capex and AI funding rather than on policy.
situation.slow: The grind is credit and AI-debt funding: CCC spreads sit above the bear line while broad high yield stays tight, and non-traded BDCs keep capping withdrawals. Korean chip exports per working day slipped against September for the first time this cycle, and Philly Fed new orders fell back into the neutral range.
situation.fast: The gap risk has moved from policy to AI-spend repricing: Alphabet's worst day on record and Amazon's drop after the late-October calls show the market punishing raised spend, and the Nvidia print in mid-November is the next after-hours trigger. Before the open, TSMC's October sales and the US October inflation print can reprice memory and rate expectations.
situation.decides: The FOMC, Samsung and the BoJ all landed calm on 10-28 to 10-30 and released their holds; Micron's FQ1 in December is the next event that holds the larger tranches. US October inflation on 11-10 and TSMC's October sales land before the open and are sign-only; the December FOMC with projections lands after the close.
situation.flips: The lean moves a group toward fizzle only on credit: a CCC spread back under the fizzle line, or a Q3 BDC tender round that fills requests in full. It moves to bear outright on a hyperscaler guiding 2027 capex flat or down, a second straight fall in Korean chip exports per working day, a December BoJ hike that snaps the carry trade, or a wider Taoyuan strike that touches production.
